verdict.rationale: Runloop's docs describe an API- and SDK-driven Devbox sandbox lifecycle an agent can drive without a human. It provisions via SDKs and the CLI (runloop-docs-23, runloop-docs-8), runs commands (runloop-docs-59), reads output through streamed or retrieved execution logs and file access (runloop-docs-60, runloop-docs-63), and shuts down via shutdown and idle controls (runloop-docs-64). The SDK rules files cover the full devbox lifecycle, and an official MCP server is documented as an agent-facing interface (runloop-docs-29, runloop-probe-4). Missing for 10: an explicit documented teardown/delete API call beyond shutdown and idle controls, an end-to-end autonomous example tying all four steps together, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
